context: Dashboard & Mobile PWA Tracker (Organic & Earthy / FinTech)

layouts.container: max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen pb-24 md:max-w-4xl lg:max-w-6xl px-4 pt-4
layouts.header: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/90 border-b border-slate-800 px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive items have data-testid attributes.
Implement mobile-first PWA dashboard with Cash In, Cash Out, Balance, Purpose, and optional Evidence Upload.
Include smart natural language / chat parser for quick transaction entry (e.g. '50000 makan siang cash out').
Include Excel export functionality (.xlsx via SheetJS or CSV fallback).
Integrate ChatGPT (GPT-5.6 Luna) AI assistant drawer/tab for financial insights and voice/text logging.
universal_guidelines: Never use complete transparent background in headers or overlays.
Use generous spacing and consistent padding inside bordered cards.
Ensure hover states have explicit text color set.
